title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 1.00 (quiet) at 01:00 UTC on 21 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 21 日 01:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 1.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest hour-start estimated Kp = 1.00 (label 1Z). Last-180 maximum 1.33 first at 23:58 UTC on 20 September (label 1P; also 01:02 UTC; last-180 window from 22:05 UTC). Published-window maximum 1.33. Window start 19:07 UTC (358 samples). 01:00 UTC follows 00:59 1.33/1P and is a real hour-start, not a trailing placeholder. 01:00 hour is still incomplete (5 samples) so the card uses the hour-start minute. estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最新整點估計 Kp = 1.00（標籤 1Z）。近 180 筆最大 1.33（最先見於 2026-09-20 23:58 UTC；標籤 1P；其後 01:02 UTC 同值；近 180 筆窗自 22:05 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 1.33。窗起點 19:07 UTC（358 筆）。01:00 UTC 接在 00:59 的 1.33／1P 之後，視為真實整點值而非尾端占位。01:00 時段尚未收滿（5 筆），主卡片採用整點分鐘。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute that is not a trailing 0.00/0Z placeholder (01:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off.
